en: Yesterday: three switches, one lamp, and you could open the door only once.
Here is the trick. Turn switch 1 on, and wait a few minutes.
Then turn switch 1 off, turn switch 2 on, and open the door.
If the lamp is on, the answer is switch number two.
If it is off, but the bulb is warm, it is switch one. If it is cold, switch three.
Person one has to boil an egg for exactly nine minutes.
There is no clock. No phone. Only two sand timers.
One takes four minutes. The other takes seven minutes.
How does Person 1 measure exactly nine minutes?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
